levels.title: First Breakfast
levels.beat: Opening: Ade jokes about the debris, Kit asks what the Corps pays in, Rhee sets the first assignment.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, so the debris field is basically a buffet. Nobody ordered it, everything is stale.
Wait, why are we catching words? What does the Corps pay in?

commsAfter.text: In words, Kit, eventually. Shape first. Catch what you can name, and the pantry shelf is next.

levels.title: Pantry Shelf
levels.beat: Teach: the loop settles in. Ade fusses over food.

commsBefore.text: A bowl is a round, open vessel. Hold the shape in your head, then reach for it.

commsAfter.text: Salt, bowl, spoon. That is just soup with extra steps. I am so proud.

levels.title: Home Sweet Hull
levels.beat: Mid: bread, home, door done. Kit asks how Rhee knows the shapes; Rhee: I wrote them down.

commsBefore.text: Home. A door. A lamp left on for someone. Easy ones, but they matter.

commsAfter.text: Rhee, how do you know what each one looks like? You never look them up.
I wrote them down. Many times. Next target, please.

commsBefore.text: Hat, coat, shoe. Somebody's wardrobe exploded. Please do not wear anything we catch.

commsAfter.text: Is that humming? It is slow, and it keeps stopping. For science, what is the song?
Hm. Was I humming? Habit. Keep going.

commsBefore.text: A blanket is a soft cover for sleeping. Longer word, same rule. Shape first.

commsAfter.text: I could nap on that pillow for a week. Do not tell Rhee. She will make a schedule.

levels.title: Quiet Corner
levels.beat: Rest: a breather with small animals.

commsBefore.text: Cat, dog, bird. A list of three, and none of them bite. I like this one.

commsAfter.text: Fine, I admit it. The dog drifted past and I said hi out loud.

commsBefore.text: Pen, book, paper. These I know best. Careful, the decoys look a lot alike.

commsAfter.text: I ___ to tell ___ about the ___. It is ... quiet here. Thank you.

commsBefore.text: Table, chair, plate, knife. Dinner is served, and it is travelling at speed.

commsAfter.text: Wait, we keep restoring things for a home nobody lives in. Who is it for?

commsBefore.text: Window, mirror, clock. Longer words now. Do not rush them, the clock will not.

commsAfter.text: I looked in the mirror tile and it looked back. Rude.

levels.title: Garden Gate
levels.beat: Rest: green, calm, a breath before the end.

commsBefore.text: Garden, tree, apple. Three for the price of one orchard. Take your time.

commsAfter.text: Hm. I used to keep one of these. Never mind. Good catching.

levels.title: Lost and Found
levels.beat: Late: counterfeits appear; Rhee warns, short.

commsBefore.text: Key, letter, phone, sign. Every one of them is for somebody. Let us find who.

commsAfter.text: Listen. Some tiles are counterfeits, close but wrong. Check every letter.

levels.title: The Crossing
levels.beat: Encounter: counterfeits close in. Closing: Tomas says water.

commsBefore.text: Counterfeits. Great. Ok ok ok, I am fine, I am a very calm person holding a very loud snack.
